description: Canonical OCS-in-a-Kit feature catalog. Feature ids are shared by OCS-Kit-Pages, OCS-Kit-Flask and OCS-Kit-Spring; each repo's kits/catalog.json maps these ids to its own code. 'core' is always on. Each feature has a category (core | general | education). Kit presets are explicit feature lists; '*' in a FEATURES override still means every feature.

general.name: General
general.description: Useful to any organization; included in Business and available to every kit.

education.name: Educational
education.description: Classroom-specific features (lessons, grading, hall pass). Included in the Education kit only; other kits can still opt in explicitly.

core.name: Core platform
core.description: Login, accounts, roles, sections/groups, profile, admin pages, blog + notebook pipeline, search.

lessons.name: Lessons
lessons.description: Course lessons and notebooks, lesson layouts, lesson progress tracking.

code-runner.name: Code runners
code-runner.description: Run student Python, JavaScript and Java in sandboxed runner containers; code-runner widgets in lessons.

assignments.name: Assignments and grading
assignments.description: Assignments, submissions, grades, quizzes, quests, certificates, evaluations, team teaching, sprint dates, student/teacher toolkit, grade predictors.

game-engine.name: Game engine
game-engine.description: JavaScript game engine, game projects (gamify, adventure/RPG), multiplayer, leaderboards, AI NPCs.

ai.name: AI assistants
ai.description: Gemini/Groq chat proxies, AI tutor chatbots, AI FRQ grading and feedback.

social.name: Social
social.description: Microblog, posts, comments, notes, announcements, chat and direct messages, personas.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: Usage analytics, GitHub contribution stats, skill snapshots, stats dashboards.

hallpass.name: Hall pass
hallpass.description: Bathroom/hall pass queues, student help queue, approval requests.

finance-sim.name: Finance simulation
finance-sim.description: Bank, stocks, crypto and mining simulation, casino-style probability games.

kasm.name: Kasm virtual desktops
kasm.description: Kasm Workspaces integration (needs a Kasm server).

face-recognition.name: Face recognition
face-recognition.description: Face registration/login (biometric data: check your school's privacy policy before enabling).

examples.name: Teaching examples
examples.description: Classroom demo code: hacks, jokes, small sample APIs and pages, media-literacy lesson.

vanilla.name: OCS Vanilla
vanilla.description: Baseline platform, suitable for giving to students: accounts, profile, blog and notebooks.

education.name: OCS Education
education.description: A full CS classroom: lessons, code runners, assignments and grading, game engine, AI tutor, calendar, analytics, hall pass.

business.name: OCS Business
business.description: Everything except classroom-specific (educational) features; customize by adding or removing features.
